summary: Visual theme migration ('Caribbean Sunshine' light) verified across 11 public pages + authenticated Dashboard, Wallet, Admin. Light off-white bg (rgb 255,253,250), navy headings, vivid orange CTAs all render correctly. Order-form 'Total' label fix confirmed (text-foreground => navy rgb(12,40,69) on Pharmacy). Login & navigation still work; admin panel loads with all KPI cards and tabs visible. One real low-contrast bug found on /pharmacy-order category badges (cyan-on-pale-cyan). One pre-existing backend 500 surfaced on Dashboard (unrelated to theme).

minor.issue: Returns 500 on /dashboard load ('Error fetching applications: AxiosError', 500). Pre-existing, NOT caused by theme migration but surfaces a visible network error in console for owner admin.

ui_bugs.issue: Badge text uses text-neon-cyan (rgb 6,214,190) on bg-neon-cyan/15 (~rgba(6,214,190,0.15)) -> measured contrast ~1.85. 'Pain Relief', 'Cold & Flu', 'Vitamins', 'First Aid', 'Digestive', 'Allergy', 'Hygiene' badges are visually pale and hard to read on white cards. Either deepen the bg to solid teal with white text, or switch text color to navy / a darker teal.

Inactive billing-cycle tab ('Business Plans' / 'Monthly') shows text-white on white card; only the active tab (dark pill bg rgb(17,24,39)) is readable. Toggle inactive label can disappear against the light card. Low confidence (single button) but worth a glance.

design_issues.screen: Global sticky header search bar (Search button)
issues: Detector falsely flagged the orange-gradient Search button — visually OK in screenshots; the bg-gold-gradient class is intact and renders orange. NOT a bug, included only for transparency about scanner output.

action_items: Fix /pharmacy-order category badges (text-neon-cyan on bg-neon-cyan/15) — replace with solid teal bg + white text or navy text on pale teal so contrast >= 4.5.
Sanity-check Pricing page billing toggle: inactive tab should use navy or muted-foreground text instead of text-white so it remains readable on light card.
(Pre-existing) Investigate Dashboard 500 from applications fetch — surfaces console errors for owner admin but does not break the page.
critical_code_review_comments: tailwind.config.js: matte-900 redefined to #FFFCF9 (light) while many components still carry 'text-white' / 'bg-matte-800' assumptions. Most have been swept, but token name 'matte-*' for light surfaces is confusing — consider renaming or removing alias mid-term.

Wallet TTD card uses gradient (orange) with text-matte-900/80 children; my detector misreads bg but it is fine. However the literal class 'text-matte-900/80' is now light text (rgb 255,252,249) on orange — relies on the gradient parent for contrast, which is brittle. Prefer explicit text-white for known-dark surfaces.

Pharmacy category badge palette inherited the dark-theme assumption: bg-neon-cyan/15 + text-neon-cyan. Light theme needs a re-skin for pastel-on-pastel combos — same pattern likely exists in Restaurants/Grocery category chips; recommend a global Badge audit.
Multiple 403s on first paint (likely /api/recommendations or anon endpoints) on every public page. Cosmetic but noisy in console — unrelated to theme.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (theme migration visually correct on 13/13 pages tested; 1 medium + 1 low contrast bug remaining)

test_credentials: Used owner admin tracyfortune@islandhoptt.com / IslandHopAdmin2026! via POST /api/auth/login -> localStorage.token. Login succeeded (200, user_type=admin).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme migration is essentially complete. Visual verification done on /, /partner, /restaurants, /car-rentals, /pharmacy-order, /grocery-order, /courier-order, /support, /pricing, /privacy-policy, /terms, /dashboard, /wallet, /admin. Pharmacy badges are the only clear-cut readability bug. The automated contrast scanner used produces false positives whenever an element sits on a gradient/colored ancestor (it walks up the DOM and stops at the first non-transparent bg — gradients return rgba 0,0,0,0). Trust the screenshots over scanner numbers for those cases. The admin panel renders all KPI tiles + tab strip (Overview, Users, Orders, Approvals, Wallet, Fraud 79, Claims 26, Incentives, Mail, Banking, Team, Zones, Whatsapp) with navy text on light cards — looks correct.
rca of the issue: Pharmacy badge readability: in the prior dark theme bg-neon-cyan/15 (~12% opacity teal on dark surface) provided enough contrast for text-neon-cyan. After theme flip, the same translucent teal now sits on a WHITE card -> the resulting near-white pastel teal background offers ~1.85 contrast against teal text. Mitigation: either (a) use bg-neon-cyan (solid) + text-white, or (b) keep bg-neon-cyan/15 but change text to text-navy-900 (or text-foreground), or (c) create a new 'badge-soft-teal' variant that pins both fg+bg explicitly for light surfaces.
